 W elcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the Under-19 Asia Cup match between India and UAE in Muscat on Tuesday.
 November 10, 2026 10:53 
 Fifth over
 Naseem. Beats Sehwag on a straighter delivery, who plays for the swing.
 November 10, 2026 10:46 
 IND 16/0 in four overs
 Hadayat continues from the other end. Starts like he did his first over, bowls it well outside the off-stump line, umpire signals wide.
 Bowls another wide outside off stump. Change of angle does not help for Hadayat, he bowls a wide down legside now.
 Hadayat pitches it up, Sehwag drives to straight to extra-cover, dot ball. Much better from Hadayat, hits the middle stump line, forces Sehwag to defend.
 Spoke too soon, make that his third wide of the over. Sehwag finally opens his account after 13 balls, pushes the length ball past mid on for FOUR! 
 November 10, 2026 10:41 
 IND 7/0 in three overs
 Naseem continues. Sehwag defends, dot ball. Sehwag defends again, dot ball. Ooh Naseem gets one to shape away off the surface, Sehwag tries to pick it up off his pads over leg but is beaten on the swing.
 Five dots in the over so far, Naseem can’t finish on a high though, delivers a loose full toss which Sehwag negotiates with an easy flick past the keeper. First boundary for India!
 November 10, 2026 10:39 
 IND 3/0 in 2 overs 
 Hadayatullah Khan to bowl the second over. Starts off with one of the widest deliveries outside you will see, goes straight to second slip. 
 Makes amends with the next two balls, bowls it inside the wide line but there’s no pace, keeps low.
 Bowls it wide outside off once again, he’s struggling to maintain his rhythm at the moment. Watchful start from Raichandani, he’s left everything outside off alone, offering no shot.
 November 10, 2026 10:31 
 IND 1/0 in one over
 Raichandani and Sehwag walk out to the middle to open the batting for India. Naseem Khan takes the new ball for UAE.
 First ball, two slips in Raichandani on strike, good start from Naseem, bowls it straight to the stumps, Raichandani defends, dot ball. 
 Naseem pitches it up, Raichandani flicks to mid on to get underway, India’s first runs on the board.
 Outside-off length ball stays low, Sehwag leaves it alone, dot ball. Two more dot balls follow, bat turns in Sehwag’s hands while attempting the straight drive. Just one run of the first over, good start with the ball from UAE.

 UAE won the toss and decided to bowl first.
